title: Går inte att förstå vad de olika abonnemangen har för skillnad
body: Snygg app som jag hade mer förhoppningar på. Har dessutom mailat typ 15 ggr med helpdesk för att försöka få förklarat för mig vad de olika abonnemangen har för olika funktioner. De svarar om och om igen att det är bara priset som är skillnaden. Låter konstigt. Om det finns flera ”pro”-versioner med olika pris så borde det väl rimligen innehålla fler funktioner i den dyrare versionen? Har begärt återbetalning för appen pga helpdesk inte kan svara på dessa frågor. Det går inte heller att se i appen vad de olika varianterna innehåller för olika funktioner. Borde finnas en tydlig bild där man kan se vad om ingår o gratis versionen, vad som ingår i den billigare betal-versionen, vad som ingår i den dyrare betal-versionen osv.

While the app has the potential to become great, to me in its current state has been distracting rather than helpful.

author: missblondesweden

title: Njää
body:
När jag redigerat en lista för vad som behöver göras så sparas den inte automatiskt och ingen spara-knapp finns. När jag ska lägga till samma aktivitet igen så hittar jag inte min redigerade lista någonstans och att kopiera den från den tidigare dagen funkar inte.
Annars gillar jag hur AI bryter ner uppgifter. Då behöver jag "bara" redigera det AI hittar på.

Utseendet är förvånansvärt plottrigt. Det blippar och ploppar överallt, små texter med "hej gör det här!" och annat jag inte vill se. Hjäälp! 🫣 

Att ha helt korta notiser en vecka, två dagar, en dag innan större aktiviteter hittar jag heller ingen funktion för, men kanske är det bara jag som inte hittar? Vilket i så fall känns märkligt, för jag brukar inte ha problem med sådant. 

Att säga upp sin provperiod funkar inte som deras egen app föreslår. Att säga upp abonnemanget ligger i appstore och inte i inställningar. Och förslaget att logga in i Tiimo (var då??) verkar konstigt för i appens egna inställningar går det bara att radera sitt konto – inte att avsluta abonnemanget. Med abonnemanget kvar får du fortfarande betala en rätt stor summa pengar per år. 

Det borde vara möjligt att få välja aktiviteter från sin kalender att lägga in, istället för allt (eller inget). 

Möjligtvis återkommer jag till denna app i framtiden och ser om den utvecklats mer. Så länge håller jag mig till apples egna med de modifikationer jag lagt till. Där finns det inget som studsar och pockar på min uppmärksamhet. Listorna får jag ha i en annan app, med kryssa i och kryssa ur funktion, där det inte heller sprattlar och rör sig, och jag hittar dem på förväntat ställe. De båda funktionerna är dessutom gratis.

title: Not for me
body:
I don’t get this app. It seems like it builds more on trying to Building a community than creating a good and useful app for planning and doing. 

I miss a possibility to check off the steps to a task. In this app I can write the steps but the only way to tick them off is to delete them, which is highly unsatisfying to me. This is the main reason to why I have deleted the app, despite the fact that I have paid a years subscription just a week ago. 

Also, the tasks I have scheduled for a day kind of disappears if I haven’t finished them.  I have to go back and find them on the day that I had originally scheduled them and move them from there by rescheduling them, which means that I in practice forget about them. (Out of sight out of mind, you know…) 

What I would have wanted is a general list where I could note down things I need to do, and from which I can pick today’s tasks, and to which unfinished tasks return when the day is over. 

I also did not like the theme and the look of this app, but that is only personal preference, and I am sure that many love it as it is.

title: Really good but needs some UI work to beat all othe apps!
body:
This is a great app that has tons of love and took a lot of time and effort. Thank you for building this!

However I suggest that you have a closer look at the Stuctured app.
 See what UI principles they use, the ease of UX and the color scheme. If you tweak your app a bit to clean up possible visual distractions and make it as minimalistic as possible you can actually change lifes of many people.
As for type and text image, i suggest looking at special ADHD tweaked type with couple of bold letters in each word. See if you can add this feature as an optional text view feature both in light and dark mode. This could beat readability and ease of follow through of all other apps.
All in all, I love this app and bought it to support you allthough I use Structured at the moment.

P.S. There used to be an tiny IOS app called Mindful Mynah, it allowed schedule assigned sounds within given streaks of time. It saved my sanity, by reminding me stay on track every 5-10-15 mins thoughout the day. (I used cockoo bird sound).
If you could add a feature like this, + some type of pomodoro add on widget and a habit tracker feature I’d happily pay 100 euros a year or 10 euros a month for this gem. Good luck guys! You rock💔

title: Amazing!!
body:

If the school administration also downloaded Tiimo we would actually have a functioning schedule that didn’t go against all workplace laws ever to exist. But until they stop drawing up our schedules in a software similar to PicCollage and then uploading them to a website no one knows exist, me and my friends who use Tiimo will be the only ones (including the teachers) who are on time. 
Thank you for making this amazing app and keeping it free, I owe you my life🙏🙏

title: I had enough!
body: I have autism and was recommended this app. At first it was a great success to be able to visually organise your life as well as importing your calendar. Brilliant! But suddenly it seems like the app is changing things by its own. It says the day is complete when it is hours left, it checks and uncheck things all by itself and it even changes times. Like for example: I have a morning routine with tasks from 9:30-11:00 which suddenly changed itself to 9:30-12:29. Totally random times and things is happening. Nothing works properly and I think it is fair to expect it to work flawless when it is a paid prescription app AND designed to help people with for example autism. I feel like it is extra important then that it works! So I had enough! The thought behind Tiimo is worth 5 stars but I can not and will not continue with Tiimo. All these weird things happening only makes me disorganised and stressed. It’s sad to leave but I leave. I give up on Tiimo.

title: Nice app!
body:
Update 01/2020-
I worry about their tracking and that makes me not use it anymore. The fact that they track everything you do, not only to get information on how the app is used in order to develop it, but also ties your content to you as a person which isn’t necessary and it feels intrusive. It makes me not wanting to use it sadly.

I think its a great app so far and the price is very fair, way cheaper than most and a long trial to really see if it makes a change in life. 
I just wish it was focused on adults too since this feels a bit too childish for someone like me. But even I love the colors and clarity it brings. as an adult who manages to work because I found my passion theres no category for any jobs. There’s many high function adhd people who still struggle with boring daily life tasks and could really use this. :) I also wish the function for routines was more exact since my off day of every week is on tuesdays and fridays and there was no option for that.  Many of us with add/adhd are creative people and doesn’t have normal 8-5 jobs for obvious reasons but we happened to find the job that we can excel in. One thing I LOVE the applewatch integration since apple watch helps me soo much with remiders and focus.

I would love an app like this for creatives who struggle to plan our daily lives but love what we do..😊 I wish there was a visual function where I could track projecs, add goals, tasks & sub tasks to see my progress and make it easier to finish them. For when I have to travel and get things done at home like setting up a kids room or finish a creative work project. But maybe the plan is to keep this app more simple?
